submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 6 mm provides the best simulated energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.10%) compared to other materials and thicknesses. It is compatible with hands-on maintenance and mechanical tolerances. No other candidate or thickness matches this performance within project constraints.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is listed as a candidate material in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: No project document or meeting note indicates any absorber interferes with maintenance; all are compatible with the support design.
Recommendation uses 6 mm plate thickness, which is inside the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Geant4 simulations show Absorber-F2 at 6 mm gives the best energy resolution (3.10%) among tested candidates and thicknesses.
